title: Indexed bit test
statement: For every bit string $x$ and natural number $i$, the Boolean indicator of the language that tests whether the indexed bit is $1$, evaluated on the encoding of $x$ and the binary representation of $i$, equals the bit of $x$ at index $i$, with false returned when that index is beyond the end of $x$.
